about: The source model of an ENVI raster (spec/zarrify/envi.md §5.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/envi.md#53-elements>): the header file, held, and the data file beside it, described in place; the table of ENVI's data types; and the roles the header, its fields, the data file and the data play, with the constraints an input must meet to have the ENVI convention's layout (spec/zarrify/envi.md §8 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/envi.md#8-envi-profile>). The parser checks them in this order; the projection reads a valid IR and its facts and checks nothing.

types.about: the data type field's codes: the Zarr data type and its bytes (codes 7, 8, 10 and 11, and any above 15, are no flat array's)

interleaves.about: the interleave field's values, lower case: the data's axes, outermost first

extensions.about: the extensions of the data file's names the profile probes for after the header's own name less .hdr, in this order

elements.about: The store IR of an ENVI input: the header file's object, held, and the data file's object, described in place. o is the header offset; B the array's bytes; Z the data file's size.

lines/<i>.extent: line i of the header file, its line end included: the magic first

data.form: {geometry: {data_type, shape}, codec: {interleave, endian, compression, skip}, recipe: [[src, 0, null]]}
data.extent: (o, B) of the data file, or (0, Z) for a gzip file

gaps/<offset>.about: the header offset's bytes of a raw data file

given.within: whether it is at most max_header

constraints.message: the ENVI header file is {size} bytes, more than 16777216

given.ok: the first line is ENVI, in any case, with spaces and tabs around it

constraints.message: not an ENVI header: its first line is not ENVI

given.ok: whether it is ENVI Standard, in any case

constraints.message: the ENVI file type "{shown}" is not supported: only an ENVI Standard file is a flat binary array

given.field: major frame offsets or minor frame offsets

constraints.message: the header has a {field} field: the data is in frames, which the profile does not read

given.field: a field the header must have

given.problem: what is wrong with it, or absent

given.ok: whether it ends in .hdr, in any case, after at least one other character

constraints.message: the ENVI header "{key}" is not named <name>.hdr, so its data file cannot be found

given.tried: the keys probed, quoted, separated by commas

constraints.message: no data file beside the ENVI header "{key}": none of {tried} exists

given.gzip: whether the data file is gzip

constraints.message: the array's {total_shown} bytes are more than 2^53 - 1
the header offset {offset} is past the end of the {size}-byte data file "{key}"
the {size}-byte data file "{key}" does not hold the header offset {offset} and the array's {total_shown} bytes, and nothing else
the {size}-byte data file "{key}" is shorter than a gzip member
the data file "{key}" does not start with a gzip header, and the header's file compression is 1
